nom: Mario Badescu Aloe Vera Alcohol-Free Toner

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the toner feels light and helps reduce midday shine and T-zone oil without heavy residue.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally report added hydration and softer, less flaky skin, though a few say it dried their skin further or did nothing.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report the toner balances oily T-zones while not over-drying drier cheek areas.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with rosacea, mostly report calm, non-irritated skin and reduced redness, but a minority describe breakouts, bumps, hives or allergic-type reactions.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her fifties with dry skin reports the toner as mild, non-irritating and suitable for her skin.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer reports the toner is mild and helps with dryness common to older skin, though no reviewer specifically credits it with visible anti-aging change.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report increased hydration and softness, especially in cold weather or after other drying treatments; a few report the toner dried their skin or did nothing.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness report visible calming or reduction, including with rosacea; one reviewer says it did not help with her specific red areas.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the toner as non-stripping and gentle after cleansing/exfoliating, restoring comfort to stressed skin; one reviewer felt it offered no real barrier benefit and was 'like water'.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fading of acne scars, hyperpigmentation and more even skin tone over weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Many acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts and calmer active blemishes; however, multiple reviewers report new breakouts, red bumps, or an allergic-type reaction they attribute to the product.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report reduced shine and oil removal from the T-zone, with the product still feeling light rather than mattifying.

aspects.libelle: Feels like plain water, no effect
Scent or dye bothers sensitive users
Bottle empties quickly with daily use
Inconsistent formula between sample and full size

extraits.texte: I have been using this product in conjunction with the Enzyme cleansing jel and the pink face spritz. This combination has been a slam dunk for me. I have had terrible, embarrassing acne since I can honestly remember.. nothing has ever clear my skin, and it really has been very hard for me to deal with emotionally. Since I started using these products, I HAVE NOT GOTTEN ONE BREAKOUT. I am completely amazed. I am never felt better in my own skin. I can't wait to try more from this line. If you have sensitive, acne prone skin- TRY THIS!!!

I've noticed a huge change in my skin texture, tone, and dryness since using this product. I usually use this twice a day, but sometimes once a day in the evening is good enough for me. My skin is sensitive and Rosacea prone with dryness. I feel that this product has made my skin glow. It looks healthier and smoother. It also isn't breaking out as much with redness as it was before. This stuff also adds much needed moisture making my skin look less dry.

I have combo skin with dry patches. Usually, after washing my face, exfoliating, and moisturizing my face looks like a whole strawberry. This is the first toner I have ever incorporated into my skincare routine. I applied it before my moisturizer and afterwards I couldn't believe that my redness was completely gone. incredible.

I have great skin with minimal effort. I've never been prone to breakouts and after dealing with upset skin for over a month I concluded it had to be this and the enzyme gel. Also after using this I noticed my skin was super dry but I didn't think anything of it because I'd follow up with serum and moisturizer. BFor the first time in my life I had continuous breakouts and dark marks as a result. It only took a week off of this for my skin to begin recovering. I am black and have normal/dry skin. I'm most concerned with hyperpigmentation, dryness and dullness.

I ordered this online during the 21 days of beauty deals. I only used this product 2 times and my whole face broke out into hundreds of little bumps. The product smelled like a wet, moldy towel. I returned it in an Ulta store and compared it to one of the new bottles they had for sale and they smelled completely different... I don't know what was in the product I received but I'm afraid I may have permanently damaged my skin. I stopped using it a week ago and the bumps have started to go away with a lot of benadryl and steroid cream I got from the dermatologist, but my skin is still not even close to what it use to be. I contacted ulta's costumer service so I hope this doesn't happen to anyone else! But please beware before you put this product on your face! I'm still living with the side effects...

I bought this because I had to get committed to a skincare routine after constant break outs and irritation. I use this after cleansing, as well as before and after masks, and I use it after dermaplaning. This soothes my sensitive and easily irritated skin immediately. I've only been using it for about a month but I can tell it really helps. There is a faint scent but I don't mind it. I typically have combination skin and often get blackheads on my chin and jawline so I can't speak for how well it works on other skin types.

52 years old here and skin has been dry. I was looking for a MILD toner that didn't have alcohol and wouldn't irritate or dry out my skin. If you have dry skin or sensitive skin, this product is PERFECT! Love it!
